title: Copilots and agents for Dynamics 365 Business Central: our new book is out!
summary: A new book published on Packt teaches how to design, build, test and govern AI solutions for Dynamics 365 Business Central, covering copilots, agents, and various implementation approaches. The book follows a fictional company through practical scenarios using AL, Copilot Studio, Azure Logic Apps, MCP, and .NET frameworks.
key_points: Business Central now includes built-in copilots and agents, with multiple ways to build custom AI solutions using different technologies.
The book addresses choosing the right approach and making AI solutions secure, testable, and affordable for production.

Chapters progress from LLM basics and Copilot Studio agents through AL copilots, testing strategies, built-in features, custom agent design, MCP integration, Azure Logic Apps workflows, and .NET development.
Readers learn through a hands-on narrative following Cronus Events company, seeing how AI solves realistic business problems.

quotes.text: The hard part is choosing the right approach and then making the solution secure, testable and affordable to run in production.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the core challenge for building production-ready AI solutions in Business Central beyond demos.

quotes.text: Systems that used to record transactions can now reason over data, take actions and automate whole processes.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the fundamental shift in ERP capabilities that the book addresses.
